MERGE [Permissions] USING (
VALUES (@p0, @p1, @p2, @p3, @p4, @p5, @p6, @p7, @p8, @p9, @p10, 0),
(@p11, @p12, @p13, @p14, @p15, @p16, @p17, @p18, @p19, @p20, @p21, 1),
(@p22, @p23, @p24, @p25, @p26, @p27, @p28, @p29, @p30, @p31, @p32, 2)) AS i ([Code], [CreatedBy], [CreatedOn], [Description], [IsActive], [IsDeleted], [ModifiedBy], [ModifiedOn], [Module], [Name], [UpdatedOn], _Position) ON 1=0
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
INSERT ([Code], [CreatedBy], [CreatedOn], [Description], [IsActive], [IsDeleted], [ModifiedBy], [ModifiedOn], [Module], [Name], [UpdatedOn])
VALUES (i.[Code], i.[CreatedBy], i.[CreatedOn], i.[Description], i.[IsActive], i.[IsDeleted], i.[ModifiedBy], i.[ModifiedOn], i.[Module], i.[Name], i.[UpdatedOn])
OUTPUT INSERTED.[Id], i._Position;
